name: Gillette India Limited
summary: Gillette India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of grooming and oral care products in India and internationally. The company operates through grooming, and oral care segment. It offers shaving system and cartridges, blades, toiletries, razors, and other components. The company also offers toothbrushes and oral care products. In addition, the company provides body shaving and trimming; skin care; and shaving gel, shaving cream and after shave; and female grooming products under the Gillette Venus brand name.
